pages.title: Two Real Resources
pages.text: $(item)TruePower$() fuels pre-ascension cultivation and lower devices. $(item)ImmortalPower$() supports later machines, teleportation and high-stage abilities. Both are ordinary items: they can be crafted, traded, stored and read by compatible automation.

pages.title: Descending Conversion
pages.text: One ImmortalPower becomes 64 TruePower; there is no reverse recipe. Recipes that explicitly require ImmortalPower always consume it and never silently substitute TruePower.

pages.title: Stages 1–5 · TruePower
pages.text: $(li)Stage 1: cap 64; gain 2 every 1,200 ticks.$(li)Stage 2: cap 128; gain 4 every 1,200.$(li)Stage 3: cap 256; gain 8 every 1,200.$(li)Stage 4: cap 512; gain 8 every 600.$(li)Stage 5: cap 1,024; gain 8 every 300.$(br2)Caps count inventory and personal storage together.

pages.title: Stages 6–10 · ImmortalPower
pages.text: $(li)Stage 6: cap 64; gain 2 every 150 ticks.$(li)Stage 7: cap 256; gain 5 every 100.$(li)Stage 8: cap 1,024; gain 16 every 50.$(li)Stage 9: uncapped; gain 32 every 20.$(li)Stage 10: uncapped and 256 every 20 by default; servers may instead make it non-consuming.

pages.title: Fuel and Light
pages.text: TruePower smelts 10 items; ImmortalPower smelts 500. Place either resource to create a dyeable light core, then use it with an empty hand to toggle its model. An ImmortalPower light also suppresses natural hostile spawning in its chunk.
